name: znetwork_extract_status_fields_from_session_desc
description: zNetwork::ExtractStatusFieldsFromSessionDesc copies the current DirectPlay session descriptor's custom status fields and session name into a status-fields view.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; coverage is functional and uses a synthetic session descriptor.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48bab0 validates copying custom event/status/value/aux fields, maxPlayers, selectedSessionIndex -1, and the session-name string into the output view.
The native zNetwork session-status smoke verifies extracted fields and session-name content.
